translation.name: Geeshsha Mas'aafaa
translation.englishName: The Holy Bible in the Dawuro language of Ethiopia, Latin script

content: Woosa Golliyaa Maaddiyaa Laappu Asatuu Dooretteeddino

He wode, kaalliyaawanttu payduu dari dari biishshin, Giriike k'aalaa haasayiyaa Ayihudatuunne Yihudaan de'iyaa Ayihudatuu walak'etteeddino; ayaw gooppe, Giriike k'aalaa haasayiyaa Ayihudatuu, «Ubbaa gallassi gishettiyaa k'umaan nu asinay hayk'k'o mac'c'awanttu naak'ettiino» yaageeddino.
Yesuusi kiitteedda tammanne laa"atuu woosa golle asaa ubbaa s'eesiide, hawaadan yaageeddino; «Nuuni S'oossaa k'aalaa odiyaawaa aggiide, k'umaa gishanaw nuw bessena.
Ishatoo, lo"a geetettiyaawantta Geeshsha Ayyaanaynne aad'd'o eratetsay kumeedda laappu asatuwaa hintte giddoppe doorite; nuuni k'ay unttuntta ha oosoo suntsana.
Shin nuuni S'oossaa woosaaninne k'aalaa oduwaan minnana» yaageeddino.

Yesuusi kiitteeddawanttu haasayeedda haasayay asaa ubbaa nashechcheedda; hewaappe guyye, ammanuunne Geeshsha Ayyaanay kumeedda Iss's'ifaanoosa, Pilip'p'oosa, P'irookoroosa, Nik'aaroona, S'imoona, P'arimeenanne Ayihudatuwaa ammanuwaan geleedda Ans's'ookiyaa Niik'olaawoosa dooreeddino.
Yaatiide Yesuusi kiitteeddawanttu sintsaan unttuntta essina, Yesuusi kiitteeddawanttu S'oossaa woosseeddawaappe guyyiyaan, barenttu kushiyaa unttunttu bolla wotseeddino.
S'oossaa k'aalay aakki aakki beedda; kaalliyaawanttu payduwaan Yerusaalamen darssi dari dari beedda; k'ay c'ora k'eesatuukka ammaneeddino.
Aad'o keekatetsaynne wolk'k'ay kumeedda Iss's'ifaanoosi, asaa giddon ooratsabaanne wolk'k'aama malaataa ootsee.

Ayiletetsaappe keseedda asaa giyaa Ayihuda ammaniyaawanttuppe, K'ereenappe, Iskkinddiriyaa asatuwaappe, Kilk'k'iyaappenne Iisiyaappe yeedda itti itti asatuu denddiide, Iss's'ifaanoosanna palumetteeddino.
Shin Iss's'ifaanoosi aad'd'o eratetsaaninne Ayyaanaan haasayiyaawaa digganaw danddaybbeykkino.
He wode unttunttu, «Muse bollanne S'oossaa bolla I boriyaa k'aalaa haasayishshin siseeddo» giyaa worddo asatuwaa shammeeddino.
Asaa ubbaa, c'imatuwaanne Muse higgiyaa tamaarissiyaawantta hank'k'etseeddino; Iss's'ifaanoosakko yiide Aa oyk'k'iide, shiik'eedda asaakko ahina,
Aa bolla s'eeseedda worddo markkatuu, «Ha bitanii ha Geeshsha Golliyaanne Muse higgiyaa boriyaawaa awudenne aggena.
Ayaw gooppe I, ‹Hawe Naazireetiyaa Yesuusi ha Geeshsha Golliyaa kolana; Muse nuw immeedda higgiyaakka laammana› yaagishin, nuuni siseeddo» yaageeddino.
Shiik'uwaan utteedda Asay ubbay Iss's'ifaanoosa akeekiide s'eelliyaa wode, Aa som"i kiitanchchaa som"iyaa malatee.
